live-walkthrough.title: A birthday dinner, from first hello
live-walkthrough.caption: Live app recording · Fictional enquiry · Waiting time shortened
live-walkthrough.voice: Alex asks for a birthday dinner at Juniper House. Type the enquiry at the main desk. FormBridge gathers five booking details for staff to review.

live-walkthrough.title: Plans change. The brief follows.
live-walkthrough.caption: Voice message → Reviewed transcript → Updated brief
live-walkthrough.voice: Alex changes the plans by voice: six guests, sometime after eight. Review the transcript before adding it. The exact time still needs an answer.

live-walkthrough.title: A little help at the desk
live-walkthrough.caption: Desk assistant → Reply draft → Staff composer
live-walkthrough.voice: Ask the desk assistant for a warm reply suggesting eight-thirty. Read its draft, use it in the staff composer, then add the message. Staff stays in control.

live-walkthrough.title: The guest’s yes makes the difference
live-walkthrough.caption: An accepted time, with the supporting messages
live-walkthrough.voice: Alex accepts eight-thirty. The time becomes ready, with the staff offer and guest acceptance linked as its sources. The earlier correction stays in the conversation.

live-walkthrough.title: Care beyond the booking
live-walkthrough.caption: Review requests → Approve the brief → Save the enquiry
live-walkthrough.voice: Review the birthday, quiet table and peanut allergy against the guest’s words. Keep the requests, approve the brief and save the enquiry. Approval does not reserve a table.

live-walkthrough.title: A calmer service starts here
live-walkthrough.caption: Service planner · Follow-ups · Enquiry book
live-walkthrough.voice: Open Service planner. The dinner appears at eight-thirty with six guests. Check the follow-up for the next shift, then find the saved conversation in the enquiry book.

live-walkthrough.voice: Guests can ask questions through the restaurant assistant. Here, it answers the kitchen-closing question using Juniper House’s approved information and shows the source.
